name: hw-spec-locator
description: Specifications, Redfish and CMDB inventory, PDU power mapping, firmware-catalog ingestion, and AI-fabric switch config for HPE and Dell infrastructure.

offline_mode.title: Air-gapped offline mode
offline_mode.description: When true, the MCP server refuses network calls and reads specs, firmware metadata, and the local mirror only from the offline bundle or the shipped dataset.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: Verify TLS certificates for Redfish, OneView, OpenManage Enterprise, CMDB, and switch APIs. Leave enabled unless a lab management processor uses a private CA.
